tables.grade:
CREATE TABLE `grade` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `student_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `class_subject_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `value` decimal(4,2) NOT NULL,
  `date` date NOT NULL,
  `institution_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
  `description` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `batch_event_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_mt3a_grade_owner` (`institution_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_grade_batch_student` (`institution_id`,`batch_event_id`,`student_id`),
  KEY `idx_grade_class_subject` (`class_subject_id`),
  KEY `idx_grade_student` (`student_id`),
  KEY `idx_mt3a_grade_student` (`institution_id`,`student_id`),
  KEY `idx_mt3a_grade_class_subject` (`institution_id`,`class_subject_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_grade_class_subject` FOREIGN KEY (`class_subject_id`) REFERENCES `class_subject` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_grade_student` FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `student` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mt3a_grade_class_subject` FOREIGN KEY (`institution_id`, `class_subject_id`) REFERENCES `class_subject` (`institution_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mt3a_grade_owner` FOREIGN KEY (`institution_id`) REFERENCES `institution` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mt3a_grade_student` FOREIGN KEY (`institution_id`, `student_id`) REFERENCES `student` (`institution_id`, `id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
